heroHeadline: Romania Extends Energy Crisis Regime to September 30 as Cernavodă Stays Dark
heroSubtitle: The government prolongs the energy sector's state of alert a full month, citing a Danube hydrological deficit still too severe to restart either Cernavodă reactor, as Ukraine and Moldovan power imports keep the grid stable; EU wildfire total climbs to 636,100 hectares while a heat dome holding 40-43°C over Italy and the Balkans keeps fire danger elevated.
footerNote: Data sourced from official reports, major outlets, and institutional analyses.
